overall_goal: Finish cooking the meat, rearrange the stovetop, and clean up the workspace

goals.description: Check and finish cooking the minced meat
goals.rationale: The person checks the meat by stirring it, then covers it and turns off the heat as it is ready.

goals.description: Rearrange pans and items to free up space on the hob
goals.rationale: The person moves pans and a mug to free up space on the hob and countertop.

goals.description: Turn on and adjust the burner
goals.rationale: The person turns on and adjusts the heat of a burner for the next cooking step.

goals.description: Clear onion residue from the spatula
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly picks up the spatula, taps it against the pot to remove stuck onion, and puts it down.

goals.description: Pick up and dispose of food trash from the floor
goals.rationale: The person picks up a piece of food trash from the floor and throws it into the food waste bin.
